title: The Way of Kings
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: On a world battered by violent storms, a war has dragged on for years across a field of broken plains. The story follows a slave who was once a soldier, a scholar with a dangerous plan, and a warlord prince who is haunted by visions.
readIf: you want an enormous, detailed fantasy with deep worldbuilding and a payoff that rewards your patience.
skipIf: you want a quick start, since it is very long and its big moments arrive after a lot of setup.

pairings.reason: Same author, faster and more contained, if you want to test his style first.
Another big, standalone world with a layered history and many viewpoints.
A grimmer, more experimental epic in a world constantly under threat from the planet itself.
